published_archive_checksum: none published by the dataset owners (checked UCI page and Siegen page on access date); our own SHA-256 of the archive is recorded in raw_checksums_wesad.json

downloaded_archive.hash_note: Computed locally on 2026-09-12 with hashlib.sha256 over the unmodified downloaded file. This is NOT a publisher-provided checksum; the dataset owners publish none (UCI and Siegen pages checked on the access date). It serves only to identify the exact bytes this project used.
top_level_members: WESAD/S<id>/ for S2-S11, S13-S17 (15 subjects; S1 and S12 absent from release)
downloaded_archive.extraction: Python zipfile.extractall into data/raw/wesad/ (creates data/raw/wesad/WESAD/); no renaming, no re-encoding; inner S<id>_E4_Data.zip left as shipped (not extracted). Original WESAD.zip retained alongside, git-ignored.
